# AfterOfficeClub Copilot instructions

Use Next.js App Router, strict TypeScript and the existing CSS token system. Preserve evidence labels and demo-mode honesty. Never invent contributors, events, opportunities, testimonials, links or successful persistence. Keep secrets server-side, validate untrusted input, protect admin mutations with database-backed authorization, and run `npm run lint`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, and `npm run build` after relevant changes.
